title: Silesian Datapack
description: A datapack that allows you to eat coal.
body:
As the title says. This is just a datapack that makes it possible to eat coal.

Note that, since it changes loot tables and recipes, it won't work with existing coal items in your world, so it's intended for new worlds/servers. Though, if you are determined enough, you can... smelt coal... to make edible coal.
